scripts.redis: wsl sh -c "redis-server || echo 'Redis not found inside WSL. Please make sure Redis is running.'"
scripts.celery: cd backend && venv\Scripts\celery.exe -A algonext worker -l info --pool=solo
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "redis,django,celery,vite" --prefix-colors "red,green,blue,magenta" "npm run redis" "npm run backend" "npm run celery" "npm run frontend"
